description: This file contains debugging and logging functions for the FreeType project, specifically for WinCE. It includes functions for error reporting, debug message output, and trace level initialization, with conditional compilation based on debug levels.

methods.name: OutputDebugStringEx
methods.description: Outputs a debug string to the Windows debugger, converting multibyte to wide characters.

methods.name: FT_Message
methods.description: Prints a formatted message to stdout and sends it to the debugger.

methods.name: FT_Panic
methods.description: Prints a formatted message and terminates the program.

methods.name: FT_Throw
methods.description: Handles error throwing, currently a stub that returns 0.

methods.name: ft_debug_init
methods.description: Initializes debug trace levels based on environment variable (if enabled).
